## SEE THE WORLD   EXTENDED

SWIR Imaging, beyond the limit of human eyes.

[SEE LIKE NEVER BEFORE](https://www.eye4nir.com/#technology-new)

## TECHNOLOGY

EYE4NIR’s technology significantly impacts a wide range of other industries, driving advancements and efficiencies across diverse applications.

## VIS-SWIR IMAGING

EYE4NIR develops novel image sensor (IS) based on germanium-on-silicon thin films that selectively detect both visible-near infrared (VIS-NIR) and short-wave infrared (SWIR) radiation within the same pixel.

![](https://www.eye4nir.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Chip-1024x1024.png)

## A Next-Gen sensing solutions

![](https://www.eye4nir.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Pic2-2.png)

## AUtomotive - From Assisted Driving to Full Autonomy

EYE4NIR’s technology ensures clear vision in compromised visibility conditions (such as low-light, fog, smoke, and haze), offers immunity to sunlight disturbances, and enables accurate assessment of road conditions.

## Industrial Automation

EYE4NIR’s technology enhances machine vision, enables precise material recognition and sorting, improves process control and quality inspections, and allows for accurate water detection.

![](https://www.eye4nir.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Pic3-1.png)

![](https://www.eye4nir.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Pic4-1.png)

## AGRI - FOOD TECH

EYE4NIR’s technology enhances food quality inspections and sorting, ensures packaging quality checks, monitors water stress and moisture levels, and optimizes irrigation control.

### OUR  TEAM   COMMITMENT

EYE4NIR is dedicated to integrating SWIR (Short-Wave Infrared) vision into daily life with our advanced, cost-effective VIS/SWIR image sensors.

Our team comprises experts in physics, electronics, and opto-electronics, with over 20 years of experience in semiconductor.

EYE4NIR’s SWIR-enhanced imaging technology aims to significantly improve road safety, reduce fatalities and injuries, and support key EU initiatives while driving innovation and economic benefits across various sectors.
